title: Globalisation and Ethics
welcome_lead: Globalisation connects markets, cultures, and crises. Ethics asks how we share responsibility.
meta_desc: French: globalisation, ethics, peace and conflict.
final_note: To name globalisation in French is to think globally in another tongue.
